usedFor: AudioPod AI runs audio jobs like transcription and text to speech; Asana plans the work around them. When “New Job Completed” or “New Job Failed” fires in AudioPod AI, “Create Project” in Asana can open a project to handle it.

bestTemplate.name: “New Job Failed” in AudioPod AI, then “Create Project” in Asana
bestTemplate.why: A failed job needs someone's attention, so it gets a project with an owner, notes and due dates instead of sitting unseen.

watchOut: Both AudioPod AI triggers can be limited to chosen job types, so set that or every job creates a project. “Create Project” also needs a workspace chosen.
